description:
Run Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents anywhere, and pick up on any device.

Vicoa (Vibe Code Anywhere) runs the AI coding agents you already use, such as Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode, on your own machine, and keeps every session in sync across desktop, web and mobile. Start a task on your laptop, follow it and reply from your phone, and get notified when an agent needs you.

Vicoa has no model of its own. It drives your existing agent CLIs through a local daemon, so you bring your own subscriptions.

The desktop app bundles the daemon and the `vicoa` command-line tool.
